tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps directly to the four-digit calendar year printed at the top of the form.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd is the boolean indicator for the CORRECTED checkbox on the form.

payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName captures the primary payer name line; however the blueprint bundles the full name into one string while the canonical schema splits into Line1 and Line2 — blueprint should split into payer_name_line1 and payer_name_line2 matching BusinessNameLine1Txt and BusinessNameLine2Txt.

payer_street_address.rationale: The canonical schema wraps payer address in PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress groups without exposing individual street/city/state/zip leaf elements in the candidate list — blueprint should split into structured address fields matching the group's child elements (AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd) inside PayerUSAddress.

payer_city_state_zip.rationale: City, state, and ZIP are separate child elements inside PayerUSAddress not individually listed in the candidates; blueprint bundles them into one string and should split into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd fields under PayerUSAddress.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly corresponds to the Payer's federal identification number box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the canonical element for the recipient's TIN/SSN on the 1099-G; note that if an EIN is used instead, RecipientEIN (idx 22) would apply, but SSN is most common and the blueprint should consider splitting by TIN type.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the RECIPIENT'S name box on the form.

recipient_street_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under RecipientUSAddress is the closest match for the recipient's street address line.

recipient_city_state_zip.rationale: City, state, and ZIP are separate child elements inside RecipientUSAddress not individually listed; blueprint bundles them into one string and should split into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd fields under RecipientUSAddress.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly corresponds to the Account number box on the form.

box_1_unemployment_compensation.rationale: UnemploymentCompAmt directly maps to Box 1 — Unemployment compensation.

box_2_state_local_tax_refunds.rationale: StateLclRefundCreditOffsetAmt maps to Box 2 — State or local income tax refunds, credits, or offsets.

box_3_box_2_tax_year.rationale: RefundCreditOffsetTaxYr maps to Box 3 — the tax year to which the Box 2 refund applies.

box_4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

box_5_rtaa_payments.rationale: RTAAPaymentsAmt directly maps to Box 5 — RTAA payments.

box_6_taxable_grants.rationale: TaxableGrantsAmt directly maps to Box 6 — Taxable grants.

box_7_agriculture_payments.rationale: AgriculturePaymentsAmt directly maps to Box 7 — Agriculture payments.

box_8_trade_or_business.rationale: TradeOrBusinessIncomeInd is the boolean indicator for Box 8 — the trade or business checkbox.

box_9_market_gain.rationale: MarketGainAmt directly maps to Box 9 — Market gain on CCC loans.

box_10a_state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp (first row) maps to Box 10a — two-letter state abbreviation.

box_10b_state_id_number.rationale: StateIdNum under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp (first row) maps to Box 10b — state payer identification number.

box_11_state_income_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp (first row) maps to Box 11 — state income tax withheld.

second_state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp represents the second row's state code when the group repeats; the schema uses a repeating group rather than separate first/second elements — blueprint should model both rows as elements within the same repeating group structure.

second_state_id_number.rationale: StateIdNum under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp represents the second row's state ID when the group repeats; same structural note as second_state applies.

second_state_income_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099GStateLocalTaxGrp represents the second row's withheld amount when the group repeats; same structural note as second_state applies.
